submitted.rationale: EQE rises steadily from the Cr-rich end to the Sb-rich end: -0.0037% at Sb=0.26, 0.0002% at 0.49, 0.0074% at 0.73, 0.0084% at 0.82 and 0.0083% at 0.84. XRD at 0.73, 0.82 and 0.84 shows a single rutile-type phase. Its peaks get stronger and shift slightly to lower Q as Sb rises, meaning the lattice expands, and no strong secondary phase appears. The EQE plateau is near Sb≈0.82. Index 25 gave the highest measured EQE.
